findings.title: Static AdminGroups are filtered out as non-SIDs
findings.evidence: `Modules/ModuleCatalog.cs:84-86` registers system-module policies such as `AdminSettings` with the static `Security:AdminGroups` array, and `Authorization/GroupAuthorizationHandler.cs:74-92` then applies `UsableSidsOnly` to every requirement, not just dynamic `section_access` rows. With the shipped/installer format `Security:AdminGroups = ["DOMAIN\\Exchange-Admins"]` (`appsettings.json.sample:37-39`, `tools/Install-ExchangeAdminWeb.ps1:468-475`), that configured group is discarded before the claims/`IsInRole` checks.
findings.predicted_failure: After deploying this range to an existing name-based `AdminGroups` config, a real member of `DOMAIN\Exchange-Admins` is denied the `AdminSettings` policy and cannot reach `/admin-settings` or module configuration pages. That locks out the global admin repair path, including the UI needed to inspect or fix section-access migration fallout.
